justification: Function only handles internal hash table cleanup with no attacker-influenced data processing.
analysis: This function processes hash table buckets for destruction but does not directly handle attacker-influenced data. The loop iterates over a fixed-size hash table based on jhash_size(t->htable_bits) which appears to be determined at initialization time rather than from external input. No memory is read or written using attacker-controlled offsets, lengths, or indices. The function properly dereferences and frees memory that was allocated during set creation, with no obvious use-after-free or null pointer dereference issues.
